Namespace: [Ankus.Testing](/api/ankus.testing/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Testing.dll`

Publishes an extension project, loads it into an isolated PostgreSQL 18+ cluster, and owns both lifetimes.
Ordinary test initialization can use this fixture without environment variables or wrapper commands.

```csharp
public sealed class PostgresExtensionTest : IAsyncDisposable
```

### StartAsync(string, PostgresInstallation?, CancellationToken)

Publishes for the host architecture using the selected installation's headers, starts a fresh cluster,
and executes CREATE EXTENSION. Build and startup failures fail initialization rather than skip tests.

```csharp
public static Task<PostgresExtensionTest> StartAsync(string projectPath, PostgresInstallation? installation = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Parameters:

`projectPath` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The extension project file.

`installation` — [PostgresInstallation](/api/ankus.pgconfig.postgresinstallation/)

The PostgreSQL installation, or null to discover PostgreSQL 18.

`cancellationToken` — [CancellationToken](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.cancellationtoken)

Cancels discovery, publication, or startup.

Returns: [Task&lt;PostgresExtensionTest&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.tasks.task-1)

The fixture to dispose after all tests finish.

Uses PostgreSQL 18's per-cluster extension search path to avoid changing the shared installation.
Server logs and build logs remain in the project's bin/ankus-test-logs directory.
